QUOTE: `mbedtls_ct_compiler_opaque()` is an empty `asm volatile("" : "+r"(x))` when GNU asm is available (`library/constant_time_impl.h:85-93`). Otherwise it XORs with a `volatile` zero global (`library/constant_time.c:29`), so the compiler cannot prove a value at compile time and cannot turn masks back into branches.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states the asm path is an empty `asm volatile("" : "+r"(x))` with x as an input-output register operand, and its purpose is to hide values from the optimizer.
